metadata.description: Personal Claude Code marketplace: one /task workflow and /lead to direct several backlog items, plus stack check plugins (frontend, server incl. Supabase), a stack-agnostic /arch architecture plugin, and a /ui design plugin.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Backlog-driven work loop as one skill: /task create, /task start, /task end. Scales planning to task size, verifies once before done, and reviews with code-review plus the stack reviewers of enabled plugins. /lead directs several items from one session: scheduled proposals from the backlog-scout agent, a work session per item, reports at plan and merge points. A Stop hook re-runs the verify command when an item is marked done.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend checks for /task start and /task end (Svelte and React references), the frontend-reviewer agent, and the frontend-evaluator agent that verifies acceptance criteria in the browser.

plugins.name: server
plugins.description: Backend and Supabase checks for /task start and /task end (any server language and Supabase: migrations, API contract, RLS, keys) and the api-reviewer and supabase-reviewer agents.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic architecture design and review: /arch design (structure, stack recommendation from a live survey, ADRs) and /arch review (maintainability, fit and extensibility against established criteria). Writes an architecture overview and ADRs; never edits code.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: UI design steps with /ui: system writes DESIGN.md from the code's tokens, mockup drafts one or several mockups on the Claude Code design canvas and records the chosen one in the repo, review checks a built screen with the design-reviewer agent.
